title: eriophyllum lanatum var. integrifolium
intro: Eriophyllum lanatum var. integrifolium, commonly known as Oregon sunshine, is a perennial herb native to the western United States. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and ease respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oregon sunshine are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
